1. (Currently Amended) An assembly comprising a test tube with an affixed MTP, wherein the MTP is embedded in a predetermined location within the test tube.

2. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded in the test tube at a position that allows for optimal reading orientation.

3. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded in the test tube underneath a surface that is oriented for reading downwards from an upper position of the test tube.

4. (Original) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the test tube is a biorepository test tube.

5. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded in polypropylene or acetal polymer.

6. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded near the center bottom of the test tube.

22. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 4, wherein the MTP is embedded near the center bottom of the test tube in a manner that allows reading from above.

23. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 4, wherein the MTP is embedded underneath the bottom surface of the test tube, oriented for reading downwards.
